svg.title: Bevel Aquarelle — watercolor design study
svg.desc: A vector concept page showing a calm watercolor-inspired desktop shell: eucalyptus desktop, warm-paper file manager, airy aqua taskbar, sage Start button and two-column Start menu, with soft watercolor washes and dark ink typography.
svg.text: Whistler-era pigment washes reimagined as a calm, crisp, modern desktop — matte color, soft depth, dark ink.

g.text: A little room for everyday things
A gentle place to begin again.

svg.text: DESKTOP STUDY / PAPER SURFACES · PIGMENT WASHES · SOFT SHADOW
Soft chroma, held in a narrow and restful tonal range.

g.text: Depth comes from wash and air.
Hairline edges, generous corners, diffuse shadows.
No glass, no hard bevels, no specular gloss strips.
A little warmth for a helpful hint.
Butter for hover · aqua for focus · sage for progress
Quiet wells · explicit focus · dark ink on every selection
Paper tabs · lilac gutters · continuous, softened geometry

svg.text: BEVEL AQUARELLE / VISUAL PROPOSAL — NOT A RUNNING APPLICATION
